correctness.rationale: Any geometrically fixed point has equal barycentric weights within each involution 2-vertex orbit. Three orbits violate alpha<=2 by producing independent triples in each bipartition class, so fixed triangulation has only graph vertices/edges. An orbit pair spans an I3 face iff the induced bipartite graph on four vertices has matching number two (Konig), exactly off-diagonal matched orbit pair or two diagonal edges, hence E(Q^sharp)=E(Q) union C(L,2) with triangles unfilled. Connectivity of G forces Q connected; graph cyclerank is |E(Q)|+C(|L|,2)-|E(Q[L])|-n+1. Bridge the two copies of arbitrary connected H at a single root to obtain a connected color-swap bipartite G with Q=H,L={root}, fixed space precisely |H|, including single-vertex boundary case. The complete I3 one-skeleton and triangular fans over graph paths contract all loops of connected ambient I3. Independent exhaustive direct independent-triple enumeration of all 1,098 symmetric incidence matrices of order at most four reproduced predicted fixed faces without using the matching criterion.
